# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the time of Anne's arrival  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v4 c2 P1](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew was an odd-looking, ungainly man with stooping shoulders and long iron-gray hair. He wore a full, soft brown beard continuously starting from the age of twenty. He dressed in a white collar and best clothes on rare formal occasions.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c21 P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031)_

## Personality

Extremely shy, quiet, and reserved, Matthew shrank from strangers and felt a profound dread of women and little girls. Despite his extreme bashfulness, he possessed a gentle, good-natured, and sympathetic heart. He was an indulgent listener who preferred silent persistence to verbal argument. Patient and wise, he harbored a deep capacity for unconditional affection and kindness.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c13 P6](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0006), [v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000)_

## History

Matthew Cuthbert spent his life working the family farm at Green Gables alongside his sister Marilla. Due to his advancing age and failing heart, the siblings arranged to adopt an orphan boy to assist with farm work, but Matthew was sent to Bright River station and accidentally brought back Anne Shirley instead. Despite his lifelong dread of women and children, he immediately took a liking to Anne and quietly persuaded Marilla to keep her. Over the following years, Matthew served as Anne's gentle champion, secretly buying her a fashionable puff-sleeved dress for a school concert and encouraging her romantic spirit. He suffered worsening heart spells and eventually died instantaneously on the porch of Green Gables after reading news of the Abbey Bank's failure. Following his death, Anne maintained a lifelong reverence for his memory, regularly visiting his grave.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c28 P48](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0048), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v4 c1 P29](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0029), [v4 c3 P57](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0057)_
